_notes.source: One of the longest-running live day trading chat rooms, added for directory credibility rather than affiliate revenue — no affiliate relationship exists. Founder (Nathan Michaud) and format confirmed directly on investorsunderground.com and cross-checked via WebSearch. Pricing is kept behind a dedicated /pricing/ page that didn't return readable content to us, so pricing is left empty rather than guessed. Trustpilot (4.5/5, 178 reviews, Excellent) confirmed directly. Skipped several of the provider's own testimonials that stated specific dollar results (e.g. a named consecutive-profit streak) per our no-performance-claims rule. Logo is the provider's own favicon.
